team_notes.ATL: Penix (ribs) expected to start per team optimism; Tagovailoa backup
team_notes.BAL: Lamar limited Wed (first practice since the Week 4 ankle sprain); Huntley started the last two. Bateman limited, no-contact jersey.
team_notes.CHI: Monangai ruled out for TNF (thumb/toe), reportedly headed to IR; Swift and Roschon Johnson handle the backfield. Jonah Jackson (OL) upgraded to full, will play TNF; Monangai OUT (NFL.com Oct 21).
team_notes.HOU: Montgomery (groin) expected out; Marks gets the bulk of the backfield, Ogunbowale passing downs (Athlon Oct 23).
team_notes.SEA: Charbonnet full practice Thu, still on PUP pending activation; good chance to debut vs KC.
team_notes.PHI: Hurts out for the season; McKee starts. Barkley limited Thu (first practice since Week 4), hopes to play Monday; kept out until he's cleared (Pierce lead). DeVonta Smith and Goedert DNP Thu.
team_notes.NE: Doubs to IR (out 4). A.J. Brown full practice Wed, off the report. Vera-Tucker and Ben Brown OUT for TNF.
team_notes.WAS: Rachaad White is the lead back with Croskey-Merritt out (Ekeler cleared, secondary).
team_notes.SF: Mike Evans DNP Wed (ribs/Achilles), Shanahan hopes he plays; Christian Kirk full practice, trending to be activated. Deebo out.
team_notes.LAC: McConkey ruled out with a concussion in Week 6; protocol makes Week 7 doubtful until cleared.
team_notes.TB: Mayfield (thumb) FULL practice Wed Oct 21; starter decision vs Jalon Daniels due Friday. Model has Daniels.
team_notes.IND: Tyler Warren (groin) was inactive in Week 6; Week 7 status unknown until Wednesday.
team_notes.CLE: Judkins ruled out (ankle plus off-field); McLaughlin and Estime share the backfield.
team_notes.LA: Davante Adams on IR (hamstring, 6-10 weeks); Atwell, Whittington and Mumpfield pick up targets behind Nacua.
team_notes.GB: Josh Jacobs off the exempt list; Sunday at DET uncertain (exemption runs through Oct 26).
team_notes.NYG: J.J. McCarthy named starter over Winston (Yahoo Oct 20). Najee Harris reportedly released; Tracy/Singletary/Skattebo in the room.
team_notes.NYJ: Breece Hall DNP Wed (quad), hasn't practiced since Week 3; Braelon Allen leads the backfield.
team_notes.ARI: Love (ankle) DNP Wed, expected to miss Week 7 per Zenitz (Oct 22), not yet ruled out; Allgeier and Knight would handle the work.
